newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Markel Corp Q2 net shr $1.72.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Markel Corp Q2 net shr $1.72.

text.p: Second quarter income from core operations increased 17 percent to $1.75 per primary share from $1.50 per primary share in 1996. For the six month period, income from core operations advanced 32 percent to $3.46 per primary share from $2.63 per primary share last year. The growth in both periods resulted from significant increases in net investment income supported by continued underwriting profitability.

Second quarter earned premiums were $84.1 million, up 18 percent from $71.4 million last year. For the six month period, earned premiums increased 12 percent to $165.8 million from $148.2 million. The growth resulted from increased retentions in the Company's core products and the acquisition of Investors Insurance Holding Corp. (Investors) in the Fall of 1996. Gross premium volume was flat for the quarter and the six month period of 1997 when compared to last year.

Second quarter net income before nonrecurring items increased 26 percent to $9.7 million, or $1.72 per primary share, compared to $7.7 million, or $1.36 per primary share, in 1996. For the six month period net income before nonrecurring items increased 20 percent to $18.5 million, or $3.28 per primary share, compared to $15.5 million, or $2.74 per primary share, last year. Substantial increase in net investment income accounted for the growth.
